build_cherry_pick_commands: build git cherry-pick commands for PRs labeled 'for patch' sorted by commit timestamp
create_release_branch_name: create a release branch name from the transformers library version string
test_prs_with_label: test all PRs with a specific GitHub label and extract their merge commit SHAs
review_commit_history: review whether a commit SHA is already present in the current branch history
run_cherry_pick_commits: run automated cherry-pick of commits from labeled PRs onto a release branch
